read: Loopback companion GET /api/post-call returns report.deal_updates[].next_step as null, omitted or an object with text, next_date, optional candidate_id and candidate_status.
write: Existing resolve-candidate through resolveConfirm. The nested candidate uses its own proposal_id and retained idempotency key. Confirming or skipping it never disposes the parent note.
review: Display the replacement text, exact date and disposition. A null next_date clears the current date. Only a pending proposal with a candidate_id offers Confirm next step and Skip next step.
